name: Minnesota Cube Day 2022
information:
You MUST read the COVID-19 Safety Protocol prior to registering. Your registration indicates you have read and understand these rules, and agree to abide by them. 

- Masks required

Unlike previous competitions this year, we will **NOT** be requiring proof of vaccination or a COVID-19 test. On top of this, we will not be limiting the number of guests per competitor. Please keep all of this in mind when planning for this competition.
